requirements.text: Patients must be able to book, cancel, or reschedule their appointments online.
Patients must be able to submit repeat prescription requests online.
Patients must have secure access to view their test results online.
System must comply with GDPR and protect patient data at all times.
The portal must be user-friendly and accessible, particularly for elderly patients or those less familiar with technology.
The appointment booking feature must include a calendar view of available slots for both GP and nurse appointments.
Patients must be able to see next available slots when rescheduling appointments.
Patients must be able to indicate if their appointment is urgent during the booking process.
Automated reminders must be sent to patients about their upcoming appointments.
Patients must be able to access their prescription history and see current medications, including dosage and frequency.
Patients must be able to input the quantity needed and additional notes for prescription requests.
Patients must receive notifications upon submission of prescription requests with estimated collection times.
Patients must receive updates if there are issues or if clinician approval is required for prescriptions.
The test result notification feature must provide secure alerts when results are ready to view.
Patients must be able to view a summary of their test results, including tests conducted, dates, and results with explanations.
Patients must have the option to download or print their test results.
Two-factor authentication must be implemented for secure access to the portal.
All patient data must be encrypted in transit and at rest.
The system must implement session timeouts to log users out after a period of inactivity.
Regular security audits must be conducted to identify vulnerabilities in the system.
A data breach response plan must be established to notify affected patients promptly in case of a data breach.
